title: Critique: the hard problem needs only that there is something it is like

statements.text: The hard problem does not depend on consciousness being intrinsic, non-physical or ineffable. All it needs is the fact that there is something it is like to be us, so showing those further features illusory leaves it untouched.

sources.quote: To generate the hard problem of consciousness, all we need is the basic fact that there is something it is like to be us.
